boundaries.name: circuit-side-signer-set-constraints
boundaries.obligation: The in-circuit thermometer, occupancy and member-root connect (update_channel_tree.rs 1049-1260) and the BlockHashChainProcessor::prove_block path are not modeled; signingSlotMirror is a handwritten restatement of only the three native-mirror rules at update_channel_tree.rs 277-316. Nothing here shows the circuit refuses A1/A2.

boundaries.name: member-root-poseidon-recompute
boundaries.obligation: The MemberTree Poseidon root is an opaque function. A2 is refused only under the explicit premise that the recomputed root over the tampered leaves differs from the committed root; the harness establishes this at runtime by hashing. No collision-freedom is assumed or proved.

boundaries.name: falcon-signature-unforgeability
boundaries.obligation: A3a rests on the Falcon leaf circuit norm bound and signature unforgeability (falcon_sig::agg); recorded as data only.

boundaries.name: agg-list-chain-binding
boundaries.obligation: A3b rests on validity_circuit.rs 242-262 (C == final.bp_sig_chain gated on the computed chain) and on the list chain commitment not colliding; recorded as data only.

boundaries.name: plonky2-refusal-and-soundness
boundaries.obligation: Refused means prove returned Err or panicked, or verify failed, on an unsatisfiable witness; proof soundness and the prover/verifier implementation are not modeled.

boundaries.name: pre-change-evidence-is-external
boundaries.obligation: The claim that the attack succeeded on the pre-Phase-3 code lives in doc/tasks and a historical worktree; it is not attested by this model.

boundaries.name: test-execution-not-attested
boundaries.obligation: The test is ignored in debug builds and runs only under --release; whether it was executed is not attested here.

boundaries.name: unblocked-steps-are-not-safety
boundaries.obligation: Steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 succeeding means the spend/withdrawal machinery pays the theft out GIVEN a settled block; the model records this expectation as data and derives no safety from it.
